reviewer: Assistant visual inspection of generated side-by-side source/output grids; not independent human scoring
score_policy: Original manual ratings unchanged; these are post-hoc qualitative notes, not replacement scores or a new reliability study

observations.observation: The source shows eight forks and requests six. The saved rewrite says to remove four forks, which is an incorrect count adjustment. A/C retain eight visible forks; B/D are nearly blank. This illustrates both a rewrite error and failure to execute even that rewrite, rather than an acceleration-specific failure.

A/C replace the original large-and-small-circle layout with several overlapping circles. B/D preserve the large circle and move the green circle toward its center, but also introduce a blue filled patch. This is a relative improvement consistent with the higher judge scores, not an error-free edit.

The requested output has six interfaces, but B/D/F show a blank charger face without the requested visible ports despite Q=83.33. E also changes the charger, plug and background substantially. The removal-of-RIKV example supports visible context disruption while exposing a mismatch between the judge rating and exact counting correctness.

B and D both show three cups where the source has two: the left cup remains while another cup appears above the right one. Their broadly similar failure receives different scores (B=58.33, D=41.67). Treat this as a score-selected discrepancy case, not independent visual proof that RegionE caused a 16.67-point semantic loss.
